test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about the definition of complex permanent tissues?

options.text: Complex permanent tissues are made up of different types of cells performing different tasks.
Complex permanent tissues are made up of different types of cells performing similar tasks.
Complex permanent tissues are made of simple permanent tissues.
Complex permanent tissues are made up of similar type of cells.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Complex permanent tissues are made up of different types of cells performing different tasks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Complex permanent tissues** are defined as plant tissues composed of **more than one type of cell** that work together as a unit. In these tissues, different cells carry out distinct sub-functions to achieve a collective goal. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• While the cells in complex tissues coordinate to perform a unified function (like conduction), the individual cell types within the tissue have specialized structures and perform **different tasks**. For example, some provide support while others transport fluids. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
 
• Complex permanent tissues are not "made of" simple permanent tissues; rather, they are a distinct category of **permanent tissues** that develop through **differentiation** from **meristematic tissues**. They may, however, contain certain types of simple cells like **parenchyma** as constituent elements. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
